cues.text: The plaza outside Port Island Station. Junpei walks up to the bench where the girl in the long, frilly dress sits drawing.
Junpei scratches his head. The girl gets up from the bench, holding her sketchboard to her chest, and walks a few steps past him. A drop of blood falls from her hand onto the paving.
The girl turns her back on Junpei and walks a few steps away, then stops.
